get.description: Staff-only operational projection. Returns every active temporal record that overlaps the closed-open window from 366 days before `at` through 366 days after `at`; there is no hidden record cap. Recurring periods are same-day local wall-clock rules in the clinic IANA timezone. Overnight work must be split at 24:00 into two weekday rows. Leave, holidays, and exceptions are UTC instants. No appointment slots are returned.
